title: Devotion to the Divine Heart of God the Father: Encompassing the Almighty Father's Call, Consecration and Promises
author: Sr. Susan Marie Claire (credited as The Author)
target_audience: Roman Catholics and Christians seeking deeper devotion
Individuals attracted to private revelation and mysticism
Devotees of the Sacred and Immaculate Hearts
Readers interested in contemporary Marian and Trinitarian devotions
Clergy and laity looking for new forms of consecration and devotion
core_themes: Recognition and veneration of God the Father as a distinct Person of the Trinity
Call for worldwide devotion to the Divine Heart of the Father
Importance of consecration to God the Father and responding to His call
Spiritual warfare, mercy, and protection in the end times
primary_purpose: To introduce and spread the devotion to the Divine Heart of God the Father as revealed through private mystical experiences, present the prayers, promises, and theology associated with it, and encourage consecration and daily practice among Christians.

structure_format.narrative_style: Explanatory and devotional, combining personal revelation, theological reflection, and instructional guidance
structure_format.organization: Divided into thematic sections, including the history of the devotion, theological explanation of the Divine Heart, prayers, consecration formula, promises, litany, and Q&A
features: Excerpts from alleged locutions or messages
Scriptural references and Catholic teaching integration

key_concepts_lessons: The Divine Heart of God the Father is presented as the source of all mercy, love, and graces.
Devotion to the Father is intended to bring peace, protection, and healing, especially in turbulent times.
Consecration and daily prayer to the Father's Heart are central practices for faithful.
The devotion is positioned as complementary to established devotions such as Sacred Heart of Jesus and Immaculate Heart of Mary.
God the Father desires to be recognized and loved distinctly within the Holy Trinity.
notable_features: Claimed private revelation and visionary experiences
Unique emphasis on the Heart of God the Father, less common in mainstream Catholic devotion
Promulgation of new consecration prayers and a specific image
Includes a set of promises akin to other classic Catholic devotions
Intended as a supplement, not replacement, to canonical doctrine
cultural_historical_context: Part of a renewed wave of Catholic mystical and devotional literature in the early 21st century, responding to a desire for deeper personal connection with all persons of the Trinity; influenced by the Catholic tradition of private revelation but not officially recognized as doctrine.
reception_impact: Mostly circulated within small Catholic circles focused on new private devotions
Appreciated by devotees seeking fresh spiritual practices centered on God the Father
Critically regarded by some as non-canonical and lacking formal Church approval
Has not achieved mainstream popularity but has a dedicated following online and in devotional communities
